items.text:
Elevated crack spreads and crude oil prices contribute to higher prices at the pump
What are crack spreads and why are they elevated? Crack spreads are indicators of the profitability of refining crude oil into petroleum products such as gasoline and diesel. One common crack spread is calculated by subtracting the spot market price of a gallon of crude oil from the wholesale price of a gallon of refined product. Since May, the gasoline crack spread in New York Harbor has averaged about $1 per gallon (gal) higher than in 2025, when the crack spread peaked around 60 cents/gal. Gasoline crack spreads are elevated primarily because of tight gasoline supplies globally.
items.title: Elevated crack spreads and crude oil prices contribute to higher prices at the pump

Elevated crack spreads and crude oil prices contribute to higher prices at the pump
What are crack spreads and why are they elevated? Crack spreads are indicators of the profitability of refining crude oil into petroleum products such as gasoline and diesel. One common crack spread is calculated by subtracting the spot market price of a gallon of crude oil from the wholesale price of a gallon of refined product. Since May, the gasoline crack spread in New York Harbor has averaged about $1 per gallon (gal) higher than in 2025, when the crack spread peaked around 60 cents/gal. Gasoline crack spreads are elevated primarily because of tight gasoline supplies globally.

Colombia Moves to Reverse Fracking Ban, Eyes $4 Billion in New Oil Investment
A regime change in Colombia’s federal government is poised to usher in an oil and gas renaissance in the South American nation. After a four-year ban on oil and gas exploration under the previous leftist president Gustavo Petro, a new right-wing administration is eager to open the country’s oil and gas reserves up to foreign investors. But while mining and oil companies are ready to pour billions of dollars into the sector, Colombia’s political systems might not actually be ready for the flood.

推动历史经典产业高质量发展 六部门联合印发意见
中新网9月7日电 据“工信微报”微信公众号消息，工业和信息化部、人力资源社会保障部、农业农村部、商务部、文化和旅游部、市场监管总局等六部门近日联合印发《关于推动历史经典产业高质量发展的意见》。历史经典产业是指丝绸、茶叶、瓷器、中药、酿造、工艺美术、文房四宝等文化底蕴深厚的中华传统特色产业。《意见》提出，到2028年，培育50家百亿规模龙头企业，塑造100个中国消费名品，打造若干千亿级规模特色产业集群，形成梯次分布、优势互补的产业布局。到2030年，培育形成一批世界一流企业和知名品牌，推动迈向全球价值链中高端。
main_items.title: 推动历史经典产业高质量发展 六部门联合印发意见

工信部：激活历史经典产业消费潜力 让老手艺“活起来、火出圈、进万家”
中新网9月7日电 国新办9月7日举行新闻发布会，介绍推动历史经典产业高质量发展有关情况。工业和信息化部副部长谢远生表示，当前，我国居民消费加快从“购买更多商品”向“获得更好服务和体验”转变，历史经典产业高度契合新时代消费升级方向，在满足物质生活需求的同时，能够带来情感共鸣、文化熏陶与审美享受，精准满足品质消费、文化消费和体验消费需求。激活历史经典产业消费潜力，绝不是简单把老产品摆上货架，而是要在产品、场景、渠道上协同发力，让老手艺“活起来、火出圈、进万家”。
main_items.title: 工信部：激活历史经典产业消费潜力 让老手艺“活起来、火出圈、进万家”
